alert.title: Worker pods restarting in a loop after a dependency bump
alert.symptoms: Since a deploy about 90 minutes ago that bumped the image-processing dependency, order-worker pods are OOMKilled every 20-30 minutes and job throughput is down by more than half.
alert.error_message: Pod order-worker OOMKilled: container memory working set reached its limit
alert.log_snippet:
2026-09-27T18:30:00Z WARN kubernetes [kubelet] Pod order-worker-5d7c OOMKilled reason=Evicted container_memory_working_set_bytes=2147483648
restart_count=11 image_resize_lib=v4.3.0

response.root_cause: Memory usage spike caused by the upgraded image-processing dependency exceeding the pod's memory limit, leading to OOMKilled restarts
response.blast_radius: All order-worker pods are affected, reducing order processing throughput by >50% and potentially delaying order fulfillment downstream
first_actions: Inspect current memory limits and actual usage of order-worker pods via metrics and logs
Rollback the image-processing dependency to the previous version or redeploy the prior container image
If rollback isn’t viable, adjust the pod memory requests/limits to accommodate the higher usage

response.root_cause: The OOM kills are caused by a memory leak in the newly upgraded image‑resize library (v4.2.0) that allocates native buffers on each thumbnail generation, causing RSS to grow until the container is killed (see INC-016).
response.blast_radius: All order‑worker pods are affected, reducing job processing throughput by ~60% and potentially delaying order fulfillment for any downstream services that rely on completed jobs.
first_actions: temporarily raise the memory limit of order‑worker pods to prevent immediate OOM while the rollback is applied
enable continuous monitoring of pod memory usage and OOM events to catch regressions early

New alert: Worker pods restarting in a loop after a dependency bump. Service: order-worker, severity: SEV1.
Symptoms: Since a deploy about 90 minutes ago that bumped the image-processing dependency, order-worker pods are OOMKilled every 20-30 minutes and job throughput is down by more than half.

Evidence (only these incidents may be cited):
Incident INC-016 (order-worker, SEV1, 2026-07-21T17:03:26Z):
Symptoms: order-worker pods repeatedly OOMKilled every 20-30 minutes since a deploy 2 hours ago; job processing throughput down 60%.
Root cause: A newly upgraded image-resize library (v4.2.0) leaks native memory buffers on each thumbnail generation call, growing pod RSS until the kubelet OOM-kills the container.
Resolver: David Kim

Ranked fixes (use the top one as first_actions[0]):

Recurrence: This is occurrence #2 of this pattern.
Team expert: David Kim (Resolved 1 incident matching this pattern with a working fix.)
